name: Open-Source-Face-Recognition-SDK
description: Face Recognition, Face Liveness Detection, Face Anti-Spoofing, Face Detection, Face Landmarks, Face Compare, Face Matching, Face Pose, Face Expression, Face Attributes, Face Templates Extraction, Face Landmarks
readme_summary: This is a free, open-source Python SDK for face recognition and analysis, designed for on-premise deployment on Windows and Linux. It leverages deep learning for high-accuracy, real-time face detection, landmark extraction, and comparison, ensuring complete data privacy.
key_features: 100% On-Premise processing
High Accuracy
Real-Time Processing
Easy Integration (Python APIs)
Cross-Platform (Windows, Linux)
GPU Optional
Completely Free (Open Source)
primary_use_case: Enabling developers to integrate robust, privacy-preserving face recognition and analysis into their applications without data leaving the user's device.
cover_image_prompt: A digital locksmith, depicted as a friendly robot with a glowing scanner, is meticulously examining a series of diverse human faces presented on floating digital frames. The robot is placing a golden key into a lock that perfectly matches one of the faces, symbolizing secure identity verification. Subtle lines of code and data streams flow around the scene, connecting the faces to the lock mechanism. The background is a clean, modern interface with a soft blue glow. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing clarity and a secure, technological feel. The repository name 'Open Source Face Recognition SDK' is subtly integrated into a digital display on the robot's arm.

name: nv
description: Neovim 0.12, собранный с нуля: проверенный код, серверы языков без сети, цвета из обоев, всё по-русски · A security-minded Neovim config built from scratch
readme_summary: This Neovim configuration, built from scratch for version 0.12, focuses on security and a streamlined coding experience. It integrates with the user's wallpaper for color themes, runs language servers offline, and provides a Russian-language interface, specifically tailored for AI-assisted code review and editing.
key_features: Offline language servers (LSP) for security
Wallpaper-based color theming (pywal)
Russian language interface and keybindings
AI-assisted code editing workflow focus
Minimal plugin count, security-audited code
Integrated file explorer and project-wide search (ripgrep)
Real-time file change detection and highlighting
Markdown rendering within the editor
Integrated terminal and image previews
primary_use_case: To provide a secure, efficient, and visually personalized Neovim environment optimized for developers who use AI assistants for code generation and require a robust code review and editing workflow.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous librarian carefully examining ancient, glowing scrolls in a dimly lit, secure vault. Each scroll represents a piece of code. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that highlights specific sections, revealing hidden patterns and potential errors with a soft, digital glow. The vault's walls are subtly patterned with abstract representations of wallpaper designs, hinting at personalized aesthetics. Small, ethereal data streams flow from the scrolls to a central, organized desk where a stylized 'nv' logo is etched. The overall mood is one of focused security, clarity, and intelligent curation. 3D isometric illustration style, with a color palette derived from a rich, deep blue and gold, emphasizing security and precision.

name: ghostty-config
description: A beautiful config generator for Ghostty terminal.
readme_summary: Ghostty Config is a web-based tool that simplifies the customization of the Ghostty terminal. It provides an intuitive interface to visually adjust settings, preview changes in real-time, and export a clean, ready-to-use configuration file.
key_features: Interactive settings editor for fonts, colors, cursor styles, transparency, blur, etc.
Rich, purpose-built input controls for various setting types
Repeatable settings management with a dedicated list editor
Hundreds of built-in Ghostty color themes
Live previews for cursors, text selections, app icons, and color palettes
Interactive terminal preview that re-themes live
Keybinding builder with interactive trigger/action editor
Import & export functionality, including config sharing via URL
Inline documentation for all settings
Per-setting indicators for platform requirements and version metadata
primary_use_case: Generating and customizing configuration files for the Ghostty terminal through a user-friendly web interface.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical workshop where a friendly artisan is using a glowing, multi-faceted crystal to sculpt and color a sleek, modern terminal window. The crystal refracts different colored light beams, representing themes and settings, which directly shape the terminal's appearance on a workbench. Input scrolls with code snippets and color swatches are neatly organized nearby. Small, ethereal particles of light emanate from the crystal, symbolizing the generated configuration. The overall mood is creative and effortless. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, inviting lighting and a clean, vibrant color palette, clearly featuring the 'Ghostty Config' name subtly integrated into the workshop signage.

name: job-ops
description: job-ops: DevOps principles applied to job hunting. A self-hosted pipeline to track, analyze, and assist your application process
readme_summary: JobOps is a self-hosted DevOps-inspired job hunting pipeline that automates the job search process. It aggregates job listings from multiple boards, scores applications based on user profiles, tailors CVs, and tracks application statuses by connecting to Gmail.
key_features: Aggregates job searches from 10+ job boards
AI-powered job scoring against user profile
Automated CV tailoring for each job description
Local PDF CV export or integration with Reactive Resume
Post-application tracking via Gmail integration (interviews, offers, rejections)
Support for multiple AI providers including local options
Self-hosted Docker deployment
primary_use_case: To significantly increase the efficiency and effectiveness of a job search by automating repetitive tasks and providing intelligent insights, all within a self-hosted environment.
cover_image_prompt: A highly organized, futuristic workbench where a skilled artisan is rapidly assembling custom-tailored suits of armor. Each suit is uniquely designed, representing a job application. Input materials like raw fabric (job listings) and blueprints (user profile) are fed into automated machines that precisely cut and stitch the armor. A digital assistant hovers nearby, displaying a dashboard with progress bars and success scores for each suit. Subtle glowing data streams and small, abstract UI elements hint at the underlying technology. The scene is brightly lit, clean, and set in a modern workshop, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and efficiency.

name: lazy-tmux
description: Lazy tmux it is a fast session manager and saver for tmux. You can save all your session and lazy restore it.
readme_summary: Lazy-tmux is a Go-based CLI tool designed to efficiently manage and save tmux sessions. It allows users to preserve detailed session states, including windows, panes, layouts, running commands, and scrollback history, enabling lazy restoration of only necessary components to conserve resources.
key_features: Save sessions (current, specific, or all) with detailed state including commands and scrollback.
Lazy restore functionality to minimize RAM usage.
Autosave daemon for periodic background snapshots.
Interactive TUI browser with fuzzy search for sessions and windows.
Keyboard-driven picker for session management.
Lightweight picker mode for Alt-Tab-style switching.
Integrations with AI coding assistants like Codex, Antex, and Claude.
Flexible sorting options for sessions and windows.
Optional fzf integration.
Bootstrap restore on tmux startup.
Full environment snapshots including pane layout and commands.
Optional scrollback capture and replay.
primary_use_case: Saving and restoring tmux sessions with their full state, including running commands and environment, to quickly resume work without manual setup.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled librarian meticulously organizing and archiving a vast collection of glowing, ethereal books, each representing a tmux session. The librarian can instantly summon any specific book or even a single page (window/pane) from the archives with a gesture, bringing it back to life on a nearby spectral desk. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float around the scene, hinting at the underlying technology. The library is dimly lit, with focused spotlights on the active books. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, organized composition and a color palette of deep blues, purples, and glowing golds, emphasizing the 'lazy' and 'restore' aspects of the 'lazy-tmux' system.
